_provenance.what: Authentic finished NFL history payload, trimmed. Every kept row is verbatim from the raw read; only whole keys and whole books were dropped.
_provenance.retrieved_by: shopper lane (one bounded public read); trimmed by ux without a new fetch
_provenance.books_kept_why: draftkings = the book pickProjectionSportsbook selects on the full payload; williamhill_us = the runner-up, so the selection is reproduced on this subset; fanduel = the reference fixture (27.0 / 7.5).
_provenance.history_note: history (the aggregate line) is kept as [] so the payload type holds; this module never reads it.
